brief:
Trump's Board of Peace, the body overseeing the US president's plan to end the Gaza war, accused both Israel and Hamas of failing to meet their commitments to halt hostilities, according to Al-Monitor. The board's criticism targeted both parties for not following through on pledges needed to resolve the conflict.

The accusation leaves Gaza's population facing continued hardship as the war persists without resolution from either side.

title: Trump's Gaza board faults Israel and Hamas for stalling war's end
